dsp.rationale: The DSP side is the documented empty passthrough with one NOP per sample and no tape delay buffer. This indicates minimal added DSP demand while CPU processing carries the effect.

memory.rationale: The module adds 200 bytes of state per track plus code and coefficient tables, while reusing stock delay rings. The common 10 MiB DRAM platform arena is shared rather than additive per instance. Moderate is an incremental footprint estimate.
